def example() -> int:
    a: object = "s"
    b: int = 1
    a, b = b, a
    return b

def example() -> None:
    a: int | str = 1
    b: int | str = "s"
    a, b = b, a
    reveal_type(a)
    reveal_type(b)

def example() -> int:
    a: object = "s"
    b: int = 1
    [a, [b]] = [b, [a]]
    return b

def one() -> int:
    return 1


def two() -> str:
    return "s"


a = one
b = two
a, b = b, a
reveal_type(a())
reveal_type(b())

expected_diagnostics.message: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Callable[[], str]", variable has type "Callable[[], int]")
